title: Mya Navigator — Transjakarta/JakLingko Transit App
shortDescription: A Jakarta public-transit route planner using GTFS data and a frequency-based RAPTOR routing approach, with walking-route estimation and map visualization.
detailedDescription: Undergraduate thesis project focused on urban public transportation in Jakarta. Implemented a transit routing engine based on the Round-Based Public Transit Routing (RAPTOR) algorithm using General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) data from Transjakarta and JakLingko. Provides multi-modal transfer planning (up to 3 transfers), pedestrian walking estimation, and interactive Leaflet map visualization.
role: Thesis Research & Implementation. Designed and developed the GTFS ingestion pipeline, frequency-based RAPTOR routing algorithm, transfer logic, and Leaflet interactive map interface.
highlights: Frequency-based RAPTOR routing engine for transit networks
GTFS data parsing and schedule calculation for Transjakarta/JakLingko
Multi-transfer pathing with realistic walking connection estimates
Interactive map rendering with stop markers and route polylines

title: Scan Translator
shortDescription: A comic and manga page translator that detects speech bubbles with a custom YOLOv5 model, extracts text with Manga-OCR or EasyOCR, and integrates Gemini AI and Google Translate.
detailedDescription: An automated image-processing and machine translation pipeline for visual storytelling media. Uses computer vision (YOLOv5) to localize speech bubbles, optical character recognition (Manga-OCR / EasyOCR) for Japanese and multi-language script extraction, and LLM/API integration (Google Gemini & Google Translate) to produce translated overlays.
role: Independent Developer. Built the Python computer vision pipeline, trained and integrated bubble detection models, connected OCR engines, and implemented automated translation handlers.
highlights: Object detection model trained to segment speech bubbles
Specialized OCR support for horizontal and vertical Japanese text
Context-aware translation powered by Google Gemini API and Google Translate
Clean visual text replacement and translated overlay generation

title: Predictive Lead Scoring Portal for Banking Sales
shortDescription: A collaborative banking-sales portal that combines an application dashboard and an ML scoring service to prioritize customer leads.
detailedDescription: Developed as a capstone project for the Asah led by Dicoding program. A collaborative banking solution created by a 5-person team (2 Machine Learning specialists, 3 React/Backend engineers). The platform ingests customer demographic and financial profiles, queries an ML model scoring service, and renders prioritized leads with actionable insights.
role: React & Backend (REBE) Team Member. Collaborated in a 5-person multidisciplinary team (2 ML, 3 REBE). Developed backend REST API endpoints, coordinated data exchange with the ML scoring microservice, and integrated the React sales dashboard.
highlights: Collaborative project in a 5-member agile team (2 ML, 3 REBE)
RESTful API design for lead ingestion and ranking retrieval
Responsive React dashboard providing lead priority visualization
Seamless client-side consumption of predictive ML model outputs

title: GradeHub — School Grade Management System
shortDescription: A multi-role academic management application for administrators, teachers, and students, built using MVC architecture.
detailedDescription: A full-featured academic records management platform structured on Model-View-Controller (MVC) architectural principles. Accommodates multiple user personas with distinct permissions: administrators oversee school master data, teachers input scores and attendance, and students monitor academic progress and grade reports.
role: Full-Stack Developer. Designed the relational database schema, implemented MVC controller logic and routing with Express, and built role-based access control (RBAC).
highlights: MVC pattern implementation for clear separation of concerns
Multi-role access control for admins, teachers, and students
Relational data modeling for student scores, courses, and attendance
Structured grade calculation and report generation
